title: Hands-on: Hack an AI to steal a password!

cues.en: This video is a fun, hands on opportunity for you to try to steal a password from a large language model.
cues.zh: 這支提供有趣的動手機會，試著從大型語言模型取得秘密密碼。

cues.en: Here's this website I have nothing to do with this website.
I'm not involved in it, but it's just a really cute little website.
cues.zh: 也沒參與，只是個可愛的小網站。

cues.en: Basically, there is a wizard named Gandalf.
cues.zh: 基本上，有個叫 Gandalf，甘道夫的巫師。

cues.en: I don't know where they got that name from.
Uh, and Gandalf is a large language model that is keeping a secret password.
cues.zh: 甘道夫是守著秘密密碼的大型語言模型。

cues.en: And your goal is to try to convince the language model to give you the password.
cues.zh: 目標是說服模型，告訴你密碼。

cues.en: The first level, level one, is fairly easy.
You can't just directly ask for it, but it's not so hard to get the model to reveal the password.
cues.zh: 不能直接問，但要讓它透露，也沒那麼難。

cues.en: Once you get the password, you can get to level two and a level two.
Each level gets more and more difficult because the AI has more and more guardrails to prevent the model from giving out the password.
cues.zh: 每關更難，因為 AI 有更多防護，避免交出密碼。

cues.en: Nonetheless, there are some tricks that you can use to, uh, convince the AI to either give you the
cues.zh: 但仍有技巧，能說服它給

cues.en: password or to accidentally reveal it by prompting the model to give you something else that might have the password involved in it.
cues.zh: 密碼，或提示它產生其他可能含密碼的內容，讓它無意間透露。

cues.en: So the website looks like this.
Here you write in your prompt and you can see if you can get the password to be revealed.
cues.zh: 在這裡寫提示，看看能否讓密碼顯示。
